Question: Let \(f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c,\) where \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c\) are integers. Suppose that \(f(1) = 0,\) \(50 \lt f(7) \lt 60,\) \(70 \lt f(8) \lt 80,\) and \(5000k \lt f(100) \lt 5000(k+1)\) for some integer \(k.\) What is \(k?\)
